rate_table_note: Rates are in R.S. 9:3542 B(2) (consumer credit transactions entered into on or after January 1, 1999, printed in words) and D (revolving loan, credit card and charge accounts). The section was last amended by Acts 1997, No. 143, eff. Jan. 1, 1998. R.S. 6:969.25 (motor vehicle credit transactions, Acts 1999, No. 794) sets the same figures; R.S. 9:3332 (consumer leases) sets higher credit life rates.
source_title: La. R.S. 9:3542, Requirement of insurance (Louisiana Consumer Credit Law; Louisiana State Legislature)
summary: Rates in force: Louisiana's maximum credit life rates for consumer credit transactions in R.S. 9:3542: 80 cents (declining balance), $1.60 (level term), $1.20 (joint) and $2.40 (joint level term) per $100 per annum from January 1, 1999, and .154 and .231 per $100 per 30-day billing period on revolving accounts. Set by statute, so a change needs legislation.
